Class AppConfig

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.config.AppConfig
public final class AppConfig extends Object
Application-wide configuration helpers for persistence and JSON processing.

The on-disk JSON store location is resolved in a fixed precedence order so operators can override the default without code changes (resolveDataDirectory()).

    • resolveDataDirectory

      public static Path resolveDataDirectory()
      Resolves the root directory holding JSON table files (users.json, etc.).

      Precedence:

      1. JVM "ta105.data.dir"
      2. Environment "TA105_DATA_DIR"
      3. When catalina.base is set (typical Tomcat): catalina.base/ta105-data
      4. Otherwise: data resolved against the JVM working directory

      The returned path is normalized (Path.normalize()) against the filesystem.

      Returns:
      absolute directory used by FileTaDatabase
